mapper.select: SELECT g.YM AS ym, g.AVG_TEMP AS avgTemp, g.POPULATION AS population, g.SUPPLY AS supply FROM gas_monthly g WHERE g.REGION_ID = #{regionId} ORDER BY g.YM
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(SUPPLY), 0) FROM gas_monthly WHERE REGION_ID = 18 AND YM LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '%')
SELECT REGION_ID, YM, AVG_TEMP, SUPPLY, POPULATION, HOUSEHOLD_CNT FROM gas_monthly WHERE REGION_ID = 18 ORDER BY YM
SELECT LEFT(g.YM, 4) AS YM, SUM(g.SUPPLY) AS SUPPLY, ROUND(AVG(g.AVG_TEMP), 1) AS AVG_TEMP FROM gas_monthly g WHERE g.REGION_ID = 18 GROUP BY LEFT(g.YM, 4) HAVING COUNT(*) = 12 ORDER BY LEFT(g.YM, 4)
SELECT MAX(y) FROM ( SELECT LEFT(YM, 4) AS y FROM gas_monthly WHERE REGION_ID = 18 GROUP BY LEFT(YM, 4) HAVING COUNT(*) = 12 ) t

SELECT REGION_ID, IFNULL(SUM(SUPPLY), 0) AS SUPPLY, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(POPULATION)), 0) AS POPULATION FROM gas_monthly WHERE REGION_ID < 18 AND YM LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, '%') GROUP BY REGION_ID ORDER BY REGION_ID
SELECT REGION_ID, YM, AVG_TEMP, SUPPLY, POPULATION, HOUSEHOLD_CNT FROM gas_monthly WHERE REGION_ID < 18 ORDER BY REGION_ID, YM
